signal: Tessell raised a $60M Series B to expand its AI-driven multi-cloud DBaaS into Europe and Asia-Pacific

email.subject1: a signal play for Tessell channel
email.body1:
David, saw Tessell closed a $60M Series B and is expanding its AI-driven platform into Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Expansion that fast usually means more channel and co-sell opportunities than the team can actually work at scale, and that is where partner-sourced pipeline quietly stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so partner coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tessell's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: three drafts to your top partners
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for Tessell.

Channel pipeline only compounds when every partner target gets a researched, timely first touch, yet most teams cannot personalize at that volume by hand as they enter new regions. That is exactly the gap our worker closes.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them, plus how the same motion runs across the rest of the channel?
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for Tessell.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how partner-sourced reply rates at Series-B infrastructure startups compare to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
David, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling channel pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up channel across new regions right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your channel? I will tailor it to Tessell either way.
